methodology.counting: Distinct official storefronts and main-product catalogs; shared ownership is recorded, aliases and copied catalogs count once.
methodology.denominator: screenedUniqueCandidates includes API attempts, retained prior reserves and discovery-only candidates; NOT_RUN is not an API failure. Individual attempt states are preserved.
methodology.landingReview: Separate read-only official webpage evidence confirms the offer remains in the same current shop; page size/time limits are diagnostic and do not relax the Store API limits.
methodology.fixtureProjection: One exact priced main-product sample per addition; original observed IDs, attributes, prices and images retained. Parent variations array pruned to the verified child only.
methodology.trust: Access admission does not grant merchant trust, affiliate approval, shipping quotes or complete configuration for every catalog item.
